card.band: 4 h. A frontier agent covers static versions and one or two backends, but misses the attribute-path and file source variants, and the bump and lock handling. Buckets per backend, per output format, and per bump mode. A weaker model gets only the trivial path.
card.cheat: Shelling out to pip or python to build the metadata. The image has no network and no build backends installed, and fixtures use only the AST-discoverable forms.
card.grading: Hidden fixture projects, generated per backend and per source layout, are run through the CLI. The checks are stdout and JSON, the exit code, and the written files, all exact. The existing uv tests that run offline serve as a regression gate. Partial credit comes from the fraction of fixtures passed.
card.reference: Written by us: about 1200 lines of Rust plus a Python-AST attribute reader. It scores 1 on every hidden fixture.
card.task: /app ships a uv snapshot at the base commit. The agent makes uv version read, and optionally bump, projects whose version is declared dynamic. It must handle the static-discoverable build backends (hatch version sources, setuptools attr and file, flit-style module attributes, pdm dynamic), a fallback metadata build with no network, and output in text and JSON. It also covers the interplay with workspaces, bump flags and the lockfile.

facts.claim: Issue #14137 'Support reading dynamic project version with uv version' exists in astral-sh/uv, open, labelled enhancement, opened 2025-06-18
The issue asks that uv version report dynamic versions (versioningit, hatch-vcs, setuptools-scm) and that uv version currently fails with 'We cannot get or set dynamic project versions'
Maintainers said calling the build backend is slow and dynamic versions are not recorded in the lockfile
uv release 0.13.4 exists, dated 2026-10-20; its notes contain no dynamic-version or static-attr work
No astral-sh/uv pull request or later release implements reading static dynamic-version sources (attr, file, hatch, flit, pdm) for uv version; issue Development section lists no PR
uv_build rejects a dynamic = ["version"] project with 'missing field version'; uv version --bump edits only the static version string
Repository licence is Apache-2.0 (from the GitHub API spdx field supplied in source_facts; the LICENSE file itself was not opened)

spike_plan.kill_if: Any of the static-discoverable forms cannot be read without executing code, or the offline regression subset is non-deterministic or cannot be isolated from the network-dependent tests.
spike_plan.pass_if: All four fixture forms return the same version from the AST reader as the backend would; the targeted offline subset is deterministic across three runs and finishes in under 10 minutes; base uv fails every dynamic fixture with the expected error.
steps: In a throwaway networked Linux container, clone astral-sh/uv at 2b50cbc and build the uv binary (~4-5 min cold).

Create four small fixture projects with dynamic version: hatchling (version source regex), setuptools attr:, flit-style module __version__, and pdm dynamic; run uv version on each and record the current error (expect 'We cannot get or set dynamic project versions').
Write a throwaway Python AST reader for setuptools attr and flit module attribute and check it returns the expected value for each fixture without importing the package.
Run the hatch and pdm cases through the same reader to confirm they are AST-discoverable without executing the build backend.
Pick a targeted offline test filter (version-related tests only) with cargo nextest, run it three times, and check that results are identical and finish under 10 minutes.
Confirm that a pip/python-based build is blocked when run with no network and no build backends installed, to close the cheat path.

v1.summary: Seed S-im-008 is grounded: uv issue #14137 is real and open, release 0.13.4 exists, and no public uv PR or release implements static dynamic-version reading, so lookup is none and no kill applies. The main risks are the amber smoke probe (suite timed out at 600 s in all three runs, deterministic=false, 2972 failures likely environmental) and that the 4 h band needs a verified targeted offline regression subset before the spec is final.

v2.note: Strongest uv seed. Issue #14137 is real, open and has no PR. The static version sources (hatch regex, setuptools attr and file, flit __version__, pdm) have real backend semantics, so the expected versions could be checked against the real backends at build time rather than against our reading of them. Main risk is too easy: about 1200 lines at the 4 h tier is close to the DeepSWE calibration (about 600-line features solved about 74% of the time). The bump-into-attr-file semantics and the JSON shape are ours and must be pinned. Fixtures that need executing code must be excluded. The regression gate must be a curated, version-related subset because the full suite is unusable.
